services.name: Banana Boat Rides
services.desc: Zoom across the postcard waters of the Gulf of Mexico and experience the thrill of hurdling over the waves on an inflatable banana boat rides in Panama City Beach. It’s the ultimate way to cool off after enjoying some time in the sun and a safe adventure for the entire family. You’ll notice our colorful banana boats splashing through the Gulf all along “The World’s Most Beautiful Beaches” from behind many of the best resorts, hotels, and condos. Check our locations to find out where you can find us. blurb: Guests can parasail over Shell Island and Panama City Beach, enjoying birds-eye views of pristine beaches and natural coastal dunes. Banana boat rides offer an adrenaline rush across the Gulf of Mexico waters. Parasailing can be signed up for directly on the beach behind resorts or scheduled in advance.
